name: Between Floors
source:
On a busy day at the office, the elevator breaks, and now you are stuck with a stranger. He seems to know a lot about you. Could there be something more to him?

[From [url=https://34deoutono.itch.io/between-floors]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
办公室里忙碌不堪的一天，电梯突然发生故障，将你与一名陌生男子困在了轿厢之中。他似乎对你了如指掌。这个男人身上，是否还隐藏着什么不为人知的秘密？

[摘自[url=https://34deoutono.itch.io/between-floors]itch.io[/url]]
